parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kitchen pot is made of stainless steel, circular in shape, and fits snugly on top of the pot.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, preventing spills and aiding in faster cooking.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the pot but does not move independently during use.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the side of the pot, likely part of a locking or release mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to control or release the lid or activate a locking mechanism for safety or convenience.
parts.Movement_description: It can be pressed or toggled, allowing mechanical interaction with the pot’s lid or body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the kitchen pot, made of aluminum, forms the container for cooking food or boiling liquids.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the contents being cooked and distributes heat evenly across its surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be lifted or moved as a whole when cooking is complete.
